name: Ruou Bau Da
summary: A rice spirit stronger than 50 degrees from Cù Lâm in An Nhơn: clear, hot, and sharp, then sweet in the throat. On Hòn Khô it is poured with the island seafood.
origin: Thôn Cù Lâm, xã Nhơn Lộc, thị xã An Nhơn.
taste: Clear, hot, and sharp in the first of the run, sweet in the throat after, and said not to leave a morning headache after a heavy night. It is also poured at weddings, funerals, and death anniversaries.
howToEat: Pour it from a height into a small cup so it foams without spilling, and drink it with seafood.
where: Cù Lâm, Nhơn Lộc, An Nhơn, the distilling village.
Hòn Khô, about 16 km out, for the seafood pairing.
seoTitle: Ruou Bau Da — the Binh Dinh rice spirit
seoDescription: Rượu Bàu Đá is a rice spirit over 50 degrees from Cù Lâm in An Nhơn, clear and sharp, poured with seafood on Hòn Khô.
